name: zeitvex
did: 建站与全部工程实现：数据闸门与校验、按品类生成页面、部件库检索与对比、参数口径页、供应商页、贡献者页；达妙 / 灵足 / 大疆 / 宇树四家的 A 级参数逐条核对（扭矩统一到输出端、缺字段一律写 null）；把「来源可追溯」做成机器可查的规则，而不是写在文档里的一句话。目录扩到 14 个品类、290 个部件（84 个 A 级）、21 台整机、22 个软件、207 家渠道；在 271 件里为 269 件补上官方来源链接；新增高擎、STACKFORCE、乐动雷达、CubeMars、脉塔、飞特等批次；本次合并 ccc 分支的 42 张产品图与整机/传感器改进，并订正首页、README、缺图清单与架构文档。新增连接器品类（线束→连接器，24 条：JST GH/SH/XH/PH/ZH、Amass XT30/60/90/MR30 与 XT30(2+2)/XT90(2+2)，另收排针、FFC/FPC、插拔端子、USB-C、DC、DB9、RJ45、SMA/BNC、GX12 等常见件）。并补 16 张连接器官方/立创产品图（JST 5、Amass 6、排针/FPC/Degson/XKB 5）。
did_en: Builds and maintains the whole engineering side: the data gate and validation, per-category page generation, the parts explorer and comparison, the semantics page, suppliers and contributors; verified every A-tier spec for DAMIAO, RobStride, DJI and Unitree (torque normalised to the output side, missing values written as null) and turned traceability into machine-checked rules. Scaled the catalogue to 14 categories, 290 parts (84 A-tier), 21 robots, 22 software items and 207 suppliers; added official source links for 269 of 271 parts; brought in High Torque, STACKFORCE, LDROBOT, CubeMars, MyActuator and Feetech batches; merged the ccc branch's 42 product images and robot/sensor improvements, and corrected the homepage, README, missing-image report and architecture docs. Added the connector category (renamed from wiring, 24 entries: JST GH/SH/XH/PH/ZH, Amass XT30/60/90/MR30 and XT30(2+2)/XT90(2+2), plus headers, FFC/FPC, pluggable terminals, USB-C, DC jack, DB9, RJ45, SMA/BNC and GX12). Also added 16 connector product images (5 JST, 6 Amass, and 5 from LCSC/Degson/XKB).

name: Dichen33
did: 整机数据 15 台（含 URDF / 仓库链接）、上位机与下位机批量扩充、IMU 与相机雷达补充—— 共 50 条数据进入目录；另写了一份《部件资料收集指南》，把「从开源项目找到型号 → 进官网 → 落地」的流程固定成规范。「遥控器」这一整个品类是 Dichen33 从 ccc 分支带进来的：5 个遥控器 + 2 个 CAN 模块（含 7 张实拍图、参数与备注），并把部件页备注改成分组卡片；另加了「首页品类卡点击后预选对应品类」（跳转带 ?cat=）。软件板块的两组也是 Dichen33 补的：「算法与方法」（DreamWaQ、BeamDojo、AMP、PPO）与「模型架构」（MLP/MoE），让软件页从「引擎+框架」扩到「引擎+框架+方法+架构」。本轮并入 ccc 分支的成果：六张整机产品图（Lite3 / TRON 1 / Go1 / A1 / B2-W / ZEX-W）、传感器按类型筛选（同类跨厂商横向比，0 计数类型也列出）、传感器细分统一命名并新增力矩传感器、整机简介分段、传感器空态提示区分「没收录 / 筛没了」。后续又补齐 42 张缺图产品图（覆盖 40 个部件：达妙 JH/S、高擎 9、脉塔 6、Stackforce 2、小米、大疆 TB47/TB48、Movella MTi-3、乐动 LD19/STL27L、Livox、RoboSense），把全站缺图从 61 降到 21，并为 JH20/8108/MTi-3 挂上可追溯的资料仓库/商城链接。
did_en: 15 whole-robot entries with URDF/repo links, a bulk expansion of high- and low-level controllers plus IMU/camera/LiDAR — 50 data rows in total — and the part-data collection guide. The remote-controller category came from the ccc branch (5 transmitters + 2 CAN modules with 7 photos), together with the grouped-card layout for part notes and the home-page category preselect. He also added the software section's two groups: algorithms & methods (DreamWaQ, BeamDojo, AMP, PPO) and model architectures (MLP/MoE). Later filled 42 missing product images (40 parts) from official sources — DAMIAO JH/S, High Torque, MyActuator, Stackforce, Xiaomi, DJI TB47/TB48, Movella MTi-3, LDROBOT, Livox and RoboSense — bringing the site's missing-image count from 61 down to 21, with traceable documentation/store links for JH20, Stackforce 8108 and MTi-3.

name: JadeCrane
did: 芯片品类从 14 颗补到 18 颗：新增 STM32H723 / TCAN334G / TMC2209 / AS5600；为 18 颗补齐官方文档页、手册 PDF 与官方仓库链接（逐条实测可打开）；补 17 颗的国内 1+ 挂牌价（含来源与采集日期）；补 12 张商品实拍图。另外登记了 doc_url / doc_pdf / repo_urls 三个参数名，让校验器的 20 条误报消失（82 → 62 警告）。
did_en: Expanded the chip category from 14 to 18 parts (STM32H723 / TCAN334G / TMC2209 / AS5600), added official doc pages, datasheet PDFs and official repos for all 18 (each link verified), domestic 1+ prices for 17 of them with source and collection date, and 12 product photos. Also registered the doc_url / doc_pdf / repo_urls keys, clearing 20 false warnings (82 → 62).
